naslov: Orkas: open-source desktop app that runs a team of 16 AI agents | AI Tool #1
opis:
An open-source (MIT) desktop app with a team of AI agents. A "Commander" turns a goal into a task list and coordinates 16 built-in agents, as well as Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode. It has projects, scheduled automations and connectors.

How to try it:
1. Go to orkas.ai/download and grab the installer (macOS 12+ or Windows 10+).
2. Sign in on first launch. You get 500 credits for the built-in model, so no API key is needed to start.
3. Optionally, add your own Claude or OpenAI key under Settings → AI Providers.
4. Create a project, describe the goal to the Commander and review what the agents return.

Price: Free. Paid plans start at $11.99 a month, and with your own key you only pay the provider.

Official link: https://github.com/Orkas-AI/Orkas

naslov: DeepSeek dsh-superagent: a free coding agent that runs parallel tasks | AI Tool #2
opis:
An MIT-licensed coding agent that listens to a single GitHub repository, splits requests into parallel tasks and launches a separate session for each. It works as a bundle for DeepSeek Harness, with a model of your choice.

How to try it:
1. Get Node.js 22.19+ or 24+, git 2.32+, Python 3.8+, tmux and GitHub CLI 2.48+.
2. Install DeepSeek Harness and create a separate profile for the superagent (instructions are at the link).
3. Connect it to a test repository and allow calls only from yourself.

Price: free (you pay for the model you use)

Official link: https://www.marktechpost.com/2026/11/01/deepseek-dsh-superagent-router-worker-coding-agent/

naslov: What is a token in AI? Explained in 30 seconds
opis:
